email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Paid Search (SEA) Expert role at WPP Media. With hands-on Google Ads experience and a strong analytical mindset, I'm excited about the opportunity to work on brands like Nespresso, Purina, and IKEA.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I've managed Google Ads campaigns, used Google Analytics and Search Console to track performance, and built reporting that informs decisions. I've also worked on SEO and content, giving me a holistic view of search. I'm fluent in English and eager to learn French or Dutch to better serve Belgian clients.

What draws me to WPP Media is the focus on curiosity and business sense over raw technical skill. I thrive on learning new platforms and tools, and I'm not afraid to say "I don't know" when I don't. I'm confident I can contribute to your Activation team and grow alongside your experts.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Paid Search (SEA) Expert position at WPP Media. With a solid foundation in digital marketing and a passion for search advertising, I am eager to contribute to your Activation team and work with renowned brands such as Nespresso, Purina, and IKEA.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience with Google Ads, managing campaigns and optimizing performance. I have used Google Analytics and Google Search Console to track and report on key metrics, ensuring that campaigns meet their objectives. My work on SEO and content has given me a comprehensive understanding of search, which I believe is valuable for Total Search projects. I am fluent in English and have a basic command of Dutch, with a strong willingness to improve.

What excites me about WPP Media is the emphasis on curiosity and business acumen. I am naturally curious and constantly seek to learn about new platforms and technologies. I am not afraid to admit when I don't know something, and I actively seek out answers. I believe that understanding the business impact of search campaigns—beyond CTR and CPA—is crucial, and I am committed to developing that perspective.

While I may not have two years of dedicated SEA experience, I have a proven track record of delivering results in digital marketing. I am a quick learner and am confident that my technical background and analytical skills will enable me to excel in this role. I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to work with a team of experts and to grow within an international group.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can contribute to WPP Media.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
